entries.title: Psalms 55:1
segments: This psalm probably refers to the rebellion of Absalom.

entries.title: Psalms 55:3
segments: Cast iniquity upon me; overwhelm me with their wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 55:4
segments: A conviction of sin as the cause of all our trouble fills the soul with anguish which is more distressing than any external trials.

entries.title: Psalms 55:5
segments:
Horror hath overwhelmed me; his horror was in view of the plans devised by enemies for his destruction; but it was aggravated by the consciousness of his own sinfulness. 
 
It is the lot of those whom God appoints to eminent stations in his church to endure great suffering in her behalf, both from inward conflicts and outward opposition.

entries.title: Psalms 55:8
segments: Windy storm and tempest; the trouble which surrounded him.

entries.title: Psalms 55:9
segments:
Divide their tongues; distract their counsels.  This was strikingly fulfilled in the case of Ahithophel's counsel. 
 
  The city; Jerusalem. 
 
The hearts of the wicked, as well as the righteous, are in the hands of God, and he can at any time divide their counsels and bring their projects to naught.

entries.title: Psalms 55:10
segments: They go about it upon the walls; violence and strife are, as it were, the watchmen of the city night and day.

entries.title: Psalms 55:12
segments:
An enemy; that is, open and avowed. 
 
  Then I would have hid myself from him; guarded myself against his assaults. 
 
The defection of former friends is harder to bear than the opposition of those who have been open enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 55:13
segments:
Thou, a man mine equal; Ahithophel. 
 
  My guide; or, my friend, as the original word is elsewhere rendered.

entries.title: Psalms 55:14
segments: In company; with the festive throng.

entries.title: Psalms 55:15
segments: Go down quick into hell; go down alive into the place of the dead, like Korah and his company.

entries.title: Psalms 55:17
segments: Regularity and constancy in prayer are essential to peace of conscience, and that joy in the Holy Ghost which is a safeguard and support in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 55:20
segments: He; the wicked man spoken of,

entries.title: Psalms 55:22
segments:
Cast thy burden upon the Lord; depend entirely on him for all needed good. 
 
Dependence on God will keep the soul in peace: when the wicked are cut off, the righteous will stand unmoved.

entries.title: Psalms 55:23
segments: Half their days; half the natural term of life: a prophecy of the premature death of David's enemies.
